verdicts.finding: The wired-annex figure — 4,289 wired / 9,115 prose = 47.1% (and the brief's '46.4%')
verdicts.measured: x6-annex re-run prints 9327 rows / 106 law / 106 short / 9115 prose / 4289 wired / 47.1% — every cell of the TOTAL row exact. An INDEPENDENT raw-byte scan of 2,191 src files (32.0 MB) with a punctuation-blind slot-masked word-window index — no module import, no AST, no JSX walker — returns 4,451 distinct wired texts and contains x6's 4,289 as a strict subset (0 rows wired by x6 but not by the raw scan). After auditing the 168 surplus rows (19 slot-only false positives, 51 weak 3–5-word, 98 substantive), the defensible independent range is 4,289–4,387 wired = 47.1%–48.1%, authored-unwired 4,826–4,728

verdicts.measured: The table does not add up: its wired column sums to 4,283 while its own TOTAL row says 4,289. The stale cell is DOSSIER_STATE — x6-annex prints 2030 / 99.6% and my independent raw scan also returns 2030. CAUSAL is worse: x6 says 8 (1.1%), the raw scan finds 129 (17.2%), and the cause is structural — 101 annex rows carry an un-stripped '— dir·SLOT' metadata tail (RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md:3712 is ``1. `after the breach of` — back·N`` vs heraldCausalGrammar.js:244 `c('after the breach of', 'back', 'N')`), and 13 rows are line-wrapped and truncated by the `^(\d+)\. (.+)$` grammar (RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md:4057 vs the complete sentence at heraldIntegrity.js:69)
